headline: IAF Hero Abhinandan Varthaman Joins Goa-Based FLY91
summary: Vir Chakra awardee Abhinandan Varthaman has joined the Goa-based regional airline FLY91 as a pilot. The airline operates out of Manohar International Airport in Mopa.

headline: Chief Election Commissioner Audits Goa's Electoral Readiness
summary: Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar visited Goa for an electoral awareness program and confirmed that the state's voting processes are fully audited. During his visit, he also toured the historic Basilica of Bom Jesus.

headline: Teenager Killed in Fatal Road Accident Near Sonsodo
summary: A 16-year-old boy, identified as Abel Menezes, lost his life following a collision between a motorcycle and a car near Sonsodo in Gogol.

headline: Four Goa Police Personnel Suspended After Assembly Assurance
summary: Following Chief Minister Pramod Sawant's assurance in the State Assembly, four police personnel, including a sub-inspector, were suspended. The disciplinary action stems from an incident of alleged misbehaviour and dispute over a restaurant bill in Porvorim.

headline: CM Sawant to Meet Karapur Villagers Post Assembly Session
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant assured the State Assembly that he will meet with the protesting villagers of Karapur once the current legislative session concludes.

headline: Goa Government to Provide Three Free LPG Cylinders Annually
summary: The Goa government has announced a scheme to provide three free LPG cylinders every year to eligible citizens. Beneficiaries will receive Rs 3,000 directly under this initiative.

headline: Delhi-Bound IndiGo Flight Makes Emergency Landing in Goa
summary: An IndiGo flight heading to Delhi was forced to return to Goa's airport and make an emergency landing after suffering an engine malfunction mid-air. All passengers and crew members on board landed safely.

headline: Goa Reports 53 Daily Dog-Bite Cases Until Mid-August
summary: Recent data reveals that Goa recorded an average of 53 dog-bite cases every day up to mid-August this year. This highlights growing concerns over stray animal management in the state.

headline: CM Sawant and LoP Clash Over Migrant Crime Statistics
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant claimed in the Assembly that over 90 percent of crimes in Goa are committed by migrants, leading to a heated debate with Leader of Opposition Yuri Alemao over law and order.

headline: Smart Meter Rollout Paused but Remains Mandatory
summary: Power Minister Ramkrishna Dhavalikar stated that while the immediate rollout of smart meters is on hold, their implementation remains mandatory in the long run.

headline: Delhi Techie Shares Cost of Remote Working in Goa
summary: A Delhi man working remotely from Goa shared his experience, detailing what a monthly budget of Rs 30,000 gets him in terms of lifestyle and accommodation.

headline: Goa's Off-Season Fades as Tourism Becomes Year-Round
summary: Industry experts note that Goa has transitioned into a year-round travel destination, effectively ending its traditional off-season. Tourists, including foreign travellers, continue to visit despite initial social media doubts.

headline: Assembly Clears Bill to Allow Housing Board Joint Ventures
summary: The Goa Assembly has passed a bill enabling the Goa Housing Board to enter into joint ventures to build affordable homes. Priority for these newly planned housing units will be given to local Goans (Niz Goenkars).

headline: Historic Artefacts Found During Saptakoteshwar Temple Restoration
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that several archaeologically significant items were unearthed during the restoration of the historic Saptakoteshwar Temple.

headline: Enforcement Directorate Allotted Land for Curca Office
summary: The Goa government has allotted a 4,000-square-meter plot of land in Curca to the Enforcement Directorate (ED) for constructing its new office.

headline: Power Minister Assures Compensation for Electrocuted Buffaloes
summary: Power Minister Ramkrishna Dhavalikar has assured local farmers that they will receive financial relief and compensation following the tragic electrocution of their buffaloes.

headline: Supreme Court Orders Goa Nightclub Fire Accused to Surrender
summary: The Supreme Court has dismissed the bail pleas of the accused in the Goa nightclub fire case, ordering Saurabh Luthra, Gaurav Luthra, and Ajay Gupta to surrender within two weeks.

headline: Goa Assembly Passes Advocate Protection Bill
summary: The Goa Legislative Assembly has successfully passed the Advocate Protection Bill to ensure the safety and security of legal practitioners in the state.

headline: Goa University Creates Visibility App for DRDO
summary: Researchers at Goa University have developed a mobile application for the DRDO to measure and predict light visibility in estuarine waters.

headline: GCA Implements 5-Year Domicile Rule for Local Players
summary: The Goa Cricket Association (GCA) has introduced a mandatory five-year domicile rule to define and select local players for state representation.

headline: CM Orders Fuel Verification Despite No E20 Petrol Complaints
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that E20 petrol is safe and has received no widespread complaints, but he will still order a verification to ensure quality.

headline: Goa Halts Plan to Introduce Anti-Conversion Bill
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the state government has shelved its plans to introduce an anti-conversion bill following internal resistance and pushback.

headline: Horticulture Corporation to Sell Coconuts at Affordable Rates
summary: In a bid to assist local consumers, the Goa Horticultural Corporation has stepped in to procure and sell coconuts at subsidized, affordable prices.

headline: Long Queues in Margao After Apostrophe Glitch Fix
summary: Citizens faced long waiting times and packed queues in Margao as officials worked to resolve an administrative software glitch involving apostrophes in names.

headline: Rapid Urbanisation Puts South Goa Coast at High Risk
summary: A recent scientific study warned that rapid urban development along the South Goa coastline has placed the region in a high-risk zone for environmental vulnerability.

headline: 16 New Bills Introduced on Day One of Assembly Session
summary: The Goa Legislative Assembly got off to a busy start, with the state government introducing 16 different bills on the very first day of the current session.

headline: Contractual Education Staff to be Regularised by October
summary: The state government announced that contractual educational staff members who have completed 10 years of service will be regularised by October this year.

headline: FDA to Re-Inspect Canteens and Eateries in Goa
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the Food and Drugs Administration (FDA) will conduct fresh rounds of inspections at local canteens and eateries to ensure health standards.

headline: Goa Adapts Security Measures Amid Evolving Threats
summary: An analysis of Goa's security systems highlights the state's ongoing efforts to update and test its law enforcement readiness to counter evolving modern threats.

headline: Yuri Alemao Backs Tiger Reserve Status in Mhadei Dispute
summary: Leader of Opposition Yuri Alemao has extended his support for declaring Mhadei a tiger reserve, while MLA Venzy Viegas demanded a firm deadline for project inspections.

headline: Crime Branch Takes Over Porvorim Shootout Investigation
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the Crime Branch of the Goa Police has officially taken over the probe into the recent shootout incident in Porvorim.

headline: Goa Fails to Achieve Electric Vehicle Adoption Target
summary: The state government cited a lack of adequate charging infrastructure and high upfront vehicle acquisition costs as the main reasons for Goa missing its target for electric vehicle (EV) adoption.
